anchors.note: Decodes the message type from fuzzed data. The messageTypeAndChunkType field dispatches to OPN handling, which creates a secure channel and processes the message — entering the vulnerable deferred-cleanup path.

Defers ALL channel cleanup — including setting channel state to CLOSED, detaching the connection, and unlinking sessions — to a delayed callback. The fix calls UA_SecureChannel_close() immediately here (which sets state=CLOSED, detaches connection, unlinks sessions) and defers only UA_SecureChannel_deleteMembers(). Without the synchronous close, the work queue inherits a dangling callback whose host allocation (channel_entry) is freed during shutdown processing and then re-read.

During the second call to UA_WorkQueue_manuallyProcessDelayed (from UA_Server_delete → UA_WorkQueue_cleanup), the linked list iteration reads the next field from memory that was freed by UA_free(dc) at line 255 during the first call (from UA_Server_run_shutdown). MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value because the freed heap memory is poisoned.

Decodes message header from the fuzzed binary data. The messageTypeAndChunkType field yields UA_MESSAGETYPE_OPN, dispatching into the OPN handler that creates a secure channel.

Allocates the channel_entry struct. The first field is UA_DelayedCallback cleanupCallback, so &entry->cleanupCallback == entry. This allocation will later be freed by UA_free(dc) in the work queue processor.
Decrypts and adds the OPN chunk to the newly created channel. On success, the message is queued for processing.
Message processing fails (retval != GOOD). processSecureChannelMessage calls Service_CloseSecureChannel, which calls UA_SecureChannelManager_close → removeSecureChannel.

Enqueues the embedded cleanupCallback (= removeSecureChannelCallback → UA_SecureChannel_deleteMembersCleanup) as a delayed work queue callback. The channel state is NOT set to CLOSED, the connection is NOT detached, and sessions are NOT unlinked at this point. The fix adds UA_SecureChannel_close(&entry->channel) before this call, which synchronously sets state=CLOSED, detaches the connection, and unlinks sessions.

After message processing returns, UA_Server_processBinaryMessage continues to use connection->channel because the connection was not detached (cleanup was deferred). The fix adds a check: if(channel->state == UA_SECURECHANNELSTATE_CLOSED) return; before this call.

During UA_Server_run_shutdown → UA_WorkQueue_cleanup (ua_server.c:553), the deferred callback is processed: removeSecureChannelCallback runs UA_SecureChannel_deleteMembersCleanup, then UA_free(dc) frees the channel_entry (dc == &entry->cleanupCallback == entry). This heap deallocation makes the memory uninitialized under MSan.

During UA_Server_delete → UA_WorkQueue_cleanup (ua_server.c:218), the SIMPLEQ linked list iteration reads the next field from memory freed at step 7. MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value. The uninitialized value was created by cfree at ua_workqueue.c:255.
